Trump renames lake Ontario as 'Lake America'

This lakes is one of the five great lake of North America that is Lake Superior, Michigan,Huron, Erie, and Ontario. 

Ontario has indigenous' origin and carries cultural significance fo canada.

Receives water from lake Erie via the Niagara river and drains into the saint Lawrence river towards the Atlantic Ocean.

Climate Diplomacy and Security , American Express , Canadian Minerals and Mining , HUMAN RIGHTS LAWS WAR-UNITED NATION AND TORTURE , U.S. Geological Survey (USGS)
comment: Geographic names often become symbols of identity and diplomacy. Beyond politics, such changes can affect indigenous recognition, cross-border cooperation, and how shared natural resources are governed.
